name: cloudflare-ddns-adaptive-heartbeat-circuit-95c2
instr:
cloudflare-ddns cannot persist per-service heartbeat health or suppress unhealthy services while probing recovery. Add adaptive recovery without changing heartbeat payloads, lifecycle capabilities, updater results, notifications, or credential redaction.

Every `BasicHeartbeat` from `NewHealthchecks` or `NewUptimeKuma` must report credential-free attempted, suppressed, rejected, or interrupted delivery, with `OK` marking success. Healthchecks classifies request, transport, status, body, and cancellation outcomes. Uptime Kuma classifies construction, transport, JSON, remote acceptance, and cancellation outcomes without gaining extended lifecycle operations.

Composed delivery evaluates eligible children independently in composition order and preserves legacy aggregate boolean semantics. Across startup, update, scheduling-failure, and shutdown operations, advance each service at most once per scheduled cycle, even when that cycle has multiple operations. Cancellation interrupts probes without recovery or replay.

Positive integer environment settings control `RecoveryPolicy` failure threshold, suppression cycles, and probe cadence. Omitted settings and explicit `DefaultRecoveryPolicy` defaults are equivalent; zero, negative, or malformed settings fail reporter setup with operator-facing diagnostics. Restore validated `CircuitSnapshot` state before delivery. Reject malformed, duplicate, or incompatible snapshots. `FileHeartbeatSource`, `CircuitStore`, and opaque `RecoveryControl
